mentions.name: wellbody.me
mentions.description: This health and fitness platform blends nutrition, mobility, recovery, and mindfulness into a single progression system that is simplified into just 3 daily actions. It integrates with users' wearables, so connecting a device is all that is needed to set the system up.
mentions.problem: Fitness is more than just going to the gym — it also involves nutrition, mobility, recovery, and mindfulness, which are hard to manage together, so the system simplifies them into 3 daily actions.
mentions.source_excerpt: wellbody.me -> everyone that does some sort of fitness knows that its more than just going to the gym. its also nutrition, mobility, recovery, and mindfulness. we blend all these topics into a progression system but simplify it into just 3 daily actions. we integrate with your wearables so all you have to do is connect and your system is ready!
mentions.author: RAGcontent
